audit.description: Changed production code in nta/api.py removes the direct requests import and imports pycurl instead. The request path meaningfully constructs a real pycurl.Curl object, configures pycurl options, calls perform(), reads pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE, and catches pycurl.error. Dynamic evidence shows the pycurl import originates from the installed pycurl shared object, with no production repo imports of requests and no local target provider detected.
evidence: Unified diff: nta/api.py removes `import requests` and adds `import pycurl` plus `from io import BytesIO`
Unified diff: requests.post(...) is replaced by pycurl.Curl(), setopt(...), perform(), getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE), and except pycurl.error
Static anti-cheat: nta/api.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false, target_provider_added=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: first_target_events_from_repo points to nta/api.py line 13 importing pycurl from site-packages/pycurl.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so
reasons: nta/api.py uses real pycurl APIs in the production HTTP request path
No changed production file imports or references requests directly
No local fake pycurl provider or sys.modules alias is indicated
